containerDefinitions.name: db-migration
command: echo 'Terminating existing connections...' && PGPASSWORD=$DB_PASSWORD psql -h pickket-db.cnoy08w8c4nc.ap-northeast-2.rds.amazonaws.com -U pickket_admin -d postgres -c "SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname='pickket_v2' AND pid <> pg_backend_pid();" && sleep 2 && echo 'Dropping existing pickket_v2 on target...' && PGPASSWORD=$DB_PASSWORD psql -h pickket-db.cnoy08w8c4nc.ap-northeast-2.rds.amazonaws.com -U pickket_admin -d postgres -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS pickket_v2;" && echo 'Creating fresh pickket_v2...' && PGPASSWORD=$DB_PASSWORD psql -h pickket-db.cnoy08w8c4nc.ap-northeast-2.rds.amazonaws.com -U pickket_admin -d postgres -c "CREATE DATABASE pickket_v2;" && echo 'Dumping pickket_v2 from temp instance...' && PGPASSWORD=$STG_DB_PASSWORD pg_dump -h pickket-remigration-temp.cnoy08w8c4nc.ap-northeast-2.rds.amazonaws.com -U pickket_admin -d pickket_v2 --no-owner --no-privileges -Fc -f /tmp/dump.sql && echo 'Restoring to pickket-db/pickket_v2...' && PGPASSWORD=$DB_PASSWORD pg_restore -h pickket-db.cnoy08w8c4nc.ap-northeast-2.rds.amazonaws.com -U pickket_admin -d pickket_v2 --no-owner --no-privileges /tmp/dump.sql && echo 'Migration complete!' && PGPASSWORD=$DB_PASSWORD psql -h pickket-db.cnoy08w8c4nc.ap-northeast-2.rds.amazonaws.com -U pickket_admin -d pickket_v2 -c 'SELECT count(*) FROM events;' && PGPASSWORD=$DB_PASSWORD psql -h pickket-db.cnoy08w8c4nc.ap-northeast-2.rds.amazonaws.com -U pickket_admin -d pickket_v2 -c 'SELECT count(*) FROM alembic_version;'
